Container.Name: error-pages
Container.Overview:
error-pages serves good-looking HTTP error pages (404, 502, 503 and others) for a reverse proxy such as Traefik, Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG or Caddy, with a choice of built-in themes. It is a tiny static server with no state.
Traefik: put this container on the same Docker network as Traefik, then add an errors middleware that points at it, for example service: http://error-pages:8080 and query: /{status}.html See the Traefik guide on the project page.
Template maintained by repires; error-pages is developed by tarampampam (MIT).

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: Host port, only needed to preview the pages or for a proxy that is not on the same Docker network. Unraid's own web UI may already use 8080; pick another port in that case.

Config.Name: Theme
Config.Description: Built-in theme: app-down, cats, connection, ghost, hacker-terminal, l7, lost-in-space, noise, orient, shuffle or win98.

Config.Name: Same status code
Config.Description: true makes the response status match the error being shown (for example 404 instead of 200).

Config.Name: Show details
Config.Description: true shows request details (host, original URI) on the error page. Leave false on anything public.
